title: UnknownEntry
description: What the LLM returns for a word the dictionary has never heard of — a compound like `decision-making`, a derived word Wiktionary never staged, an Indian-English usage. Unlike EntryGeneration there is no Wiktionary extract to translate: the model writes the senses as well as the Hindi, and `ipa` with them. An empty `senses` array is the model saying it does not recognise the token (a name, a scanning error, another language); the route turns that into the ordinary 404 and charges nothing. Definitions are duplicated from dictionary-entry.json (not $ref'd across files) because OpenAI strict mode needs a self-contained schema.

ipa.description: IPA transcription without surrounding slashes. Empty string when unsure.

hindiPronunciation.description: Devanagari transliteration of the English pronunciation, e.g. फ़ॉर्चून. Empty only when `senses` is empty.

senses.description: Commonest first. Empty means the model does not recognise the token.
